svg.title: Arnav Parashar
svg.desc: I build software systems that hold together. CS at BITS Pilani. I work across AI agents, automation, interfaces and the infrastructure underneath. A black notch at the top springs open into a Dynamic Island where NotchHub's pixel fox says hi, builds NEO 2.0, listens for the wake word and celebrates shipping NotchHub. NEO 2.0: 52 tools, ~20 ms routing, 0.90 intent accuracy.

g.text: CS at BITS Pilani, building AI agents
an AI agent that uses your Mac like you do
wake word, speech and routing on device
a Dynamic Island for the notch. I live here.
